The map shows (2,7)='@' and (3,7)='P'. No 'o' at (2,7). So the notice board is NOT rendered as a blocking object on the map. Yet observe says it's at (2,7) and blocks.

This is contradictory. The map says (2,7) is walkable ('@'), but observe says the notice board is there and blocks. 

Maybe the notice board is at (2,7) but the map legend doesn't render notices (only 'o' for blocking objects like doors/benches). And the notice board is a "blocks" object that the map doesn't show. So I'm standing on a notice board that the map doesn't render, and I'm stuck.

But wait — if the map shows '@' at (2,7), the game thinks I'm there and it's walkable. So why can't I move?

Let me try moving to (3,7) — the player's tile. Maybe the player is not actually blocking and I can swap.
